export default {
  apiVersion: 1, languageVersion: 3, name: "科技信息片头标题",
  kind: "generator", mode: "dynamic", width: 1920, height: 1080,
  durationSeconds: 4, seed: 42,
  parameters: {
    title: {type: "text", title: "主标题", default: "把复杂的事做简单", maxLength: 40},
    subtitle: {type: "text", title: "副标题", default: "痕迹 AI", maxLength: 40},
    tag: {type: "text", title: "状态标签", default: "HENJI AI · OPENING", maxLength: 40},
    meta: {type: "text", title: "数据角标", default: "1920x1080 · 30FPS", maxLength: 40},
    accent: {type: "color", title: "强调色", default: [0.3255, 0.8235, 0.8784, 1], animatable: true},
    exitAt: {type: "number", title: "退场起点（秒）", default: 3.68, min: 0.5, max: 3.9, step: 0.02}
  },
  render(ctx) {
    const W = ctx.width;
    const H = ctx.height;
    const bg = [0.0471, 0.0824, 0.1294, 1];
    const panelFill = [0.0863, 0.1412, 0.2039, 0.88];
    const fg = [0.9137, 0.9529, 0.9804, 1];
    const muted = [0.5451, 0.6471, 0.7216, 1];
    const titleFont = "HarmonyOS Sans Medium";
    const subFont = "HarmonyOS Sans";
    const monoFont = "JetBrains Mono";
    const x0 = W * 0.18;
    const y0 = H * 0.28;
    const pw = W * 0.64;
    const ph = H * 0.42;
    const innerW = pw - H * 0.12;
    const corner = H * 0.05;
    const thick = max(2, H * 0.0023);
    const glowR = H * 0.018;
    const accent = ctx.params.accent;
    const open = tween(ctx.time, 0.05, 0.45, 0, 1, "quartOut");
    const padX = (1 - open) * W * 0.03;
    const padY = (1 - open) * H * 0.04;
    const gridIn = tween(ctx.time, 0, 0.35, 0, 1, "quartOut");
    const scan = progress(ctx.time, 0.3, 1.3);
    const rule = progress(ctx.time, 1.25, 0.42);
    const subIn = progress(ctx.time, 1.3, 0.4);
    const out = tween(ctx.time, ctx.params.exitAt, 0.32, 1, 0, "cubicIn");
    return [
      rect({id: "bg", x: 0, y: 0, width: W, height: H, fill: bg}),
      group({id: "grid", opacity: 0.18 * gridIn}, [
        repeat(17, i => rect({id: "grid-x", x: i * W / 16, y: 0, width: 1, height: H, fill: muted})),
        repeat(10, j => rect({id: "grid-y", x: 0, y: j * H / 9, width: W, height: 1, fill: muted}))
      ]),
      group({id: "hud", opacity: clamp(out, 0, 1)}, [
        rect({id: "panel", x: x0, y: y0, width: pw, height: ph, fill: panelFill, opacity: open}),
        rect({id: "corner-tl-h", x: x0 - padX, y: y0 - padY, width: corner, height: thick, fill: accent, glow: {radius: glowR, intensity: 1.6, color: accent}}),
        rect({id: "corner-tl-v", x: x0 - padX, y: y0 - padY, width: thick, height: corner, fill: accent, glow: {radius: glowR, intensity: 1.6, color: accent}}),
        rect({id: "corner-tr-h", x: x0 + pw + padX - corner, y: y0 - padY, width: corner, height: thick, fill: accent, glow: {radius: glowR, intensity: 1.6, color: accent}}),
        rect({id: "corner-tr-v", x: x0 + pw + padX - thick, y: y0 - padY, width: thick, height: corner, fill: accent, glow: {radius: glowR, intensity: 1.6, color: accent}}),
        rect({id: "corner-bl-h", x: x0 - padX, y: y0 + ph + padY - thick, width: corner, height: thick, fill: accent, glow: {radius: glowR, intensity: 1.6, color: accent}}),
        rect({id: "corner-bl-v", x: x0 - padX, y: y0 + ph + padY - corner, width: thick, height: corner, fill: accent, glow: {radius: glowR, intensity: 1.6, color: accent}}),
        rect({id: "corner-br-h", x: x0 + pw + padX - corner, y: y0 + ph + padY - thick, width: corner, height: thick, fill: accent, glow: {radius: glowR, intensity: 1.6, color: accent}}),
        rect({id: "corner-br-v", x: x0 + pw + padX - thick, y: y0 + ph + padY - corner, width: thick, height: corner, fill: accent, glow: {radius: glowR, intensity: 1.6, color: accent}}),
        rect({id: "scan", x: x0, y: y0 + ph * scan, width: pw, height: max(2, H * 0.0028), fill: accent, opacity: 0.5 * (1 - scan), glow: {radius: H * 0.02, intensity: 2, color: accent}}),
        text({id: "tag", x: x0 + H * 0.06, y: y0 + ph * 0.16, text: ctx.params.tag, fontFamily: monoFont, fontWeight: 400, fontSize: H * 0.026, letterSpacing: H * 0.004, color: muted, baseline: "bottom", opacity: clamp(open, 0, 1)}),
        text({id: "meta", x: x0 + pw - H * 0.06, y: y0 + ph * 0.16, text: ctx.params.meta, fontFamily: monoFont, fontWeight: 400, fontSize: H * 0.026, letterSpacing: H * 0.004, color: muted, align: "right", baseline: "bottom", opacity: clamp(open, 0, 1)}),
        text({id: "title", x: W / 2, y: y0 + ph * 0.4, text: ctx.params.title, fontFamily: titleFont, fontWeight: 500, fontSize: H * 0.11, letterSpacing: -H * 0.0022, align: "center", baseline: "middle", maxWidth: innerW, maxLines: 2, lineHeight: 1.15, color: fg, perChar: (i, n) => ({y: tween(ctx.time, 0.5 + stagger(i, 0.85 / n), 0.3, H * 0.012, 0, "quartOut"), opacity: progress(ctx.time, 0.5 + stagger(i, 0.85 / n), 0.22), scale: 1, rotation: 0})}),
        line({id: "rule", x1: W / 2 - W * 0.09, y1: y0 + ph * 0.62, x2: W / 2 + W * 0.09, y2: y0 + ph * 0.62, width: 2, color: accent, trimStart: (1 - rule) / 2, trimEnd: 1 - (1 - rule) / 2, glow: {radius: H * 0.014, intensity: 1.2, color: accent}}),
        text({id: "subtitle", x: W / 2, y: y0 + ph * 0.73 - (1 - subIn) * H * 0.01, text: ctx.params.subtitle, fontFamily: subFont, fontWeight: 400, fontSize: H * 0.042, letterSpacing: H * 0.006, align: "center", baseline: "middle", maxWidth: innerW, maxLines: 1, color: muted, opacity: subIn})
      ])
    ];
  }
}
